sections.changelog:
Added

  • **Wholesale price mapping.** The field-mapping screen now offers a «Wholesale Price» column (placed right after «Old Price»). When mapped, the value is read from the price list and stored on its own product field (`_mvweb_pi_wholesale_price`), kept fully separate from the retail and old price so it never affects the storefront price. Auto-detect recognises common wholesale column names, and the value is refreshed on every import; a feed that omits it leaves the stored wholesale price untouched.
  • **Wholesale price in generated feeds.** Feeds produced on the Feeds screen now carry the wholesale price as a `` element (only when a product has one), the same way the barcode is exported. It is emitted separately from ``/``, so it never changes the price shown to aggregators, and it round-trips: re-importing such a feed reads the wholesale price back automatically.
  • **Wholesale price field in the product editor.** The imported wholesale price is now shown as an editable field under the price inputs on the WooCommerce product screen, so it can be seen and corrected by hand. It is stored on its own and never used as the storefront price — displaying or using it on the front end is left to the theme (read the `_mvweb_pi_wholesale_price` product meta).

Fixed

  • **Auto-detect no longer sources the retail price from a wholesale or old-price column.** Column detection now prefers an exact header match before falling back to a partial match, and a column already claimed by one field can't be reused by another. Previously several price columns shared the substring «цена», so the retail price could be mapped to a wholesale/old-price column when it appeared first in the file.
  • **Custom YML tags and Cyrillic `` names are now mappable.** Any non-standard offer tag is read (not just a fixed set), so a supplier-specific element becomes available in the field mapping. Cyrillic parameter names are transliterated to distinct, readable keys instead of collapsing into a single one, so parameters like «Оптовая цена» no longer overwrite each other. Latin parameter names are unchanged.
  • **Removing a warehouse no longer leaves its stock in the catalogue.** A warehouse dropped from the settings had its already-downloaded price file left behind, and a manual conversion could still merge that "ghost" warehouse's stock into the total. Leftover files are now deleted when a warehouse is removed and ignored if any remain, so a product stocked only there correctly goes out of stock on the next import while multi-warehouse products keep just the remaining locations' quantity. A duplicate SKU within a single warehouse file is now logged and the first row kept, matching single-source behaviour.
